newsitem.title: USA: Petrolite sees Q4 EPS between $0.51-$0.53.
newsitem.headline: Petrolite sees Q4 EPS between $0.51-$0.53.

text.p: Petrolite Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to post earnings per share for the fourth quarter ended Ocotber 31 in the range of $0.51 to $0.53 a share.
That compares with a profit of $0.19 a share before a $0.79 a share charge for the write-off of inventory and assets a year ago, the specialty chemical maker said.
The company also said it expected earnings per share for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 to be more than 100 percent higher than the $0.29 a share reported in fiscal 1996.
The 1997 estimate excludes non-recurring items, such as the sale of its Singapore facility, which is expected to net Petrolite an after-tax gain of $3 million in the quarter, Petrolite said.
Shares of Petrolite rose 4-1/4 to 39-1/4 on Nasdaq Wednesday.
